# FG-EDGE-0005

> **廃止済み** — 新しいコードでは使わないこと。

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `wave_plan_must_end_at_100_percent` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 展開の波・停止の規則・保守の時間帯の設定が正しくありません。値を直してください。
- en: The rollout's waves, halt rules or maintenance windows are not valid. Fix the values.
- id: Gelombang, aturan penghentian, atau jendela pemeliharaan rollout tidak valid. Perbaiki nilainya.

## 原因 (cause)

Retired 2026-11-25 (plan 21 E1b, ADR-0041 Amendment): the waves, halt policy and maintenance windows were removed from forge-edge, so nothing raises this code any more; it stays registered because codes are never reused. Before: plan 21 §5.3–§5.6 (ADR-0041 §5–§7): forge-edge refused a wave plan, a halt policy or a maintenance schedule. `reason`: wave plan — `no_waves`, `too_many_waves` (> 10), `canary_not_first`, `percent_range` (a percentage outside 0.01..=100 %, in basis points 1..=10000), `percent_not_increasing` (each wave must reach more devices than the one before, so membership is monotonic), `last_wave_not_100`; halt policy — `min_sample` (1..=1000), `failure_rate` (1..=10000 basis points), `min_failures` (1..=1000), `unresponsive_rate` (1..=10000 basis points), `done_ratio` (100..=10000 basis points), `soak` (canary or percent soak over 30 days), `stall_after` (1 hour..=90 days); schedule — `time_zone` (not an IANA zone name in the compiled-in tz database; `subject` names it), `window_start` (not HH:MM), `window_duration` (1..=1440 minutes), `too_many_windows` (> 64), `blackout_order` (a blackout that does not end after it starts), `too_many_blackouts` (> 256).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The problem's `reason` and `subject` (the field, wave index, zone name or window) say which value. Nothing was stored.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the value: waves strictly increasing to 100 % (a canary wave only first), thresholds in range, IANA zone names such as `Asia/Jakarta`, windows as weekday + HH:MM + minutes.
